mentions.name: Sophai Radars
mentions.description: This tool combines RSS and other sources to create "radars" for executives — curated feeds for tracking many ongoing developments. It grew out of the builder's personal problem of keeping track of so many things going on.
mentions.problem: Born out of a personal problem of keeping track of so many things that are going on.
